## Which file do I download?

| Your device | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **Android** phone or tablet | `UmbraPDF-{version}.apk` | Open it and tap **Install**. If Android warns about an unknown app, allow your browser or Files app to install apps. If Play Protect warns, tap **More details → Install anyway**. |
| **Windows** 10/11 (64-bit) | `UmbraPDF-{version}-Windows-Setup.exe` | Run it. If SmartScreen warns, click **More info → Run anyway**. Then start **Umbra PDF** from the Start menu: it opens in your browser. |
| Windows, without installing | `UmbraPDF-{version}-Windows-Portable.zip` | Unzip it anywhere and double-click **Umbra PDF.cmd**. |
| **Linux** (x64) | `UmbraPDF-{version}-Linux.tar.gz` | Unpack it and run `./umbra-pdf.sh`. |

Everything runs on your own device; nothing is uploaded. On Windows and Linux, Umbra PDF opens in your browser at `http://127.0.0.1:5180/` and only this computer can reach it. Close its window to stop it. To check a download, compare it with `SHA256SUMS-*.txt`.
